messages:
Maya: Tiny poll  who wins in a bar fight: YAML with a mysterious tab, or Semver with a surprise major bump? :face_with_monocle:
Diego: YAML. Its passive-aggressive. One wrong indent and it ruins your night.
Zoe: Semver shows up late and drops the major bomb, then leaves. classic dramatic energy. :sweat_smile:
build-bot: CI: :warning: parsing error in infra/config.yaml: sequence item expected at line 9
Maya: offending excerpt:
```yaml
env:
  - name: FEATURE_FLAG
    value: "true"
   - name: EXPERIMENT
     value: "on"
```
Diego: Oof. That dash hierarchy is a crime scene.
Zoe: New office incentive: if your YAML breaks CI, you bring snacks to the next standup. Immediate cultural remediation. :pretzel:
Maya: also: semver policy proposal  if you bump major, you buy lunch for the team. Fair deterrent.
Diego: I support both snack-based and lunch-based deterrents. Death by sugar is a good motivator.
build-bot: :white_check_mark: Added config linter to CI. Repeats of this error will trigger an automated nudge to run `prettier --check` on YAML files.
Zoe: can we get a sticker: "I respect YAML whitespace"? will trade for one semver apology card.
Maya: agreed. I'll draft the apology card template: "Dear team, sorry for the midnight major bump. Love, v3.0.0" :laughing:
Diego: love it. Closing poll: tabulated result  YAML: 2, Semver: 1. YAML wins by mysterious formatting.
